BenpayVideo.description: Create a video from text with BenPay.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Choose a model or enter its ID.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Describe the video you want to create.

duration.name: Duration (seconds)
duration.tooltip: Set the video duration in seconds.

generation.name: Generation
generation.tooltip: Keep unchanged to resume the existing task. Use Regenerate to start another video.

BenpayVideoFromImages.description: Create a video from images or reference videos with BenPay.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Choose a model or enter its ID.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Describe the video you want to create.

duration.name: Duration (seconds)
duration.tooltip: Set the video duration in seconds.

image_mode.name: Image mode
image_mode.tooltip: Choose first frame, first and last frame, reference images, or reference video (Doubao only).

images.name: Images
images.tooltip: Reference images: Doubao 1-4; MiniMax 1-5. First-frame modes require one or two images.

reference_video_urls.name: Reference video URLs
reference_video_urls.tooltip: Doubao only. Enter at most 4 HTTPS reference video URLs, one per line.

generation.name: Generation
generation.tooltip: Keep unchanged to resume the existing task. Use Regenerate to start another video.
